dead_code_reported_path.details: Reported GSM8K, OOD, and bootstrap functions have formal worker/audit call sites.

gt_provenance.details: Dataset-provided answers are parsed and hash-validated; predictions are not used as ground truth.

result_existence.details: Nine evidence sources exist and match byte counts and SHA-256; raw generations and adapters are not in Git.

scope.details: One 1.5B model, one main budget, one candidate pool, arithmetic-focused tasks.

score_normalization.details: Reported accuracy is a fixed-denominator mean of numeric-correctness indicators; no self-max normalization.
